name: Check weekly AI API budgets with HTTP Request and OperatorNest

parameters.content:
## Check weekly AI API budgets

For operators checking a recurring API workload before the next week starts.

### How it works
Every Monday at 09:00 UTC, the workflow sends token volumes to the public cost API. It estimates seven days of usage for each selected model and emails when any estimate exceeds your weekly threshold or has missing rates. Models are alternatives for the same workload. Estimates exclude non-token charges. API failures stop the run; check execution errors.

### Setup
Edit the example token volumes, request volumes, model IDs and threshold in Budget inputs. Set your email connection, sender and recipient before publishing. Test a low threshold that sends an alert, then a high threshold that sends none. Change the trigger and workflow time zone to match your reporting day.

Calculation by [OperatorNest](https://operatornest.com/tools/ai-api-cost-calculator?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=weekly-api-budget). No OperatorNest account required.

## Prepare and calculate
Receive the inputs and call the public tool API.

## Check the threshold
Email only when an estimate needs attention.
